_comment: Provenance record for demo models that this repository did not produce.
Used by scripts/fetch_demo_models.sh to verify the committed copies against
their published source, and to restore one if it is missing or corrupt.
First-party weights (AIArcheology, HroudaDetector15) are deliberately absent:
they have no upstream to verify against. See ios/MLBrowser/iOS/Drivers/Demo Models/LICENSE.md
